news.summary: QBit Semiconductor Ltd. (TWO: 7913), a fabless semiconductor company, was officially listed on the Taiwan Emerging Stock Board on May 15. This milestone marks a significant step in the company's expansion toward global capital markets and reinforces its position in high-performance silicon solutions.
